maddeler.e:
نزدلف (form VIII)
# نَزْدَلِفُ (nazdalifu) /naz.da.li.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
# نُزْدَلَفُ (nuzdalafu) /nuz.da.la.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
# نَزْدَلِفَ (nazdalifa) /naz.da.li.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
# نُزْدَلَفَ (nuzdalafa) /nuz.da.la.fa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
